subject: Marine Works - Magdalen Islands - Havre-Aubert
text:
Marine Works - Magdalen Islands - Havre-Aubert
Dredging operations taking from 1000 UTC to 2200 UTC, 7 days a week beginning 21 Oct 2026 at the Havre-Aubert fishing port at 47 14.239N 061 49.460W. Dredge, barges, and tugs on site. 
Minimum wake requested.
